title: Sum of Gaussian vectors and large sets
summary: We prove that the convexity problem of M. Talagrand is equivalent to the subgaussian vector problem: can any centered $1$-subgaussian random vector in $\mathbb{R}^n$ be realized as the sum of a universal number of standard Gaussian vectors? We introduce methods to study this problem and, using elementary arguments, we settle it for $1$-subgaussian random variables and random vectors with good norm and covariance bounds.
